title: Muhammad ﷺ event timeline (one file per language)
description: The 108 events of the Prophet's life, grouped into six eras. One file per language (muhammad.ar.json, muhammad.en.json, muhammad.de.json). Identical ids and ordering across languages; only strings differ.

quranTranslation.description: The published Qur'an edition every verse in this file is quoted from. Present on translated files only. Its `attribution` string must be displayed wherever a verse appears.

dateCaveat.description: The source document's warning about Hijri→Gregorian conversion. The UI must surface this wherever Gregorian dates appear, so they are not read as astronomically exact.

eras.description: The six sections of the source document. Rendered as the outermost (most zoomed-out) level of the timeline.

id.description: Row number in the source document. Stable identifier used in URLs.

slug.description: Language-neutral readable id, identical across languages.

order.description: Chronological position; equals id in the current dataset.

title.description: Event name for the timeline circle, e.g. 'عام الفيل'. Taken from the bolded lead of the source cell.

summary.description: Event detail. Inline markdown; ** marks key terms and quoted verses.

hijri.description: Verbatim Hijri expression, including hedges ('نحو', 'تقريبًا', 'على المشهور'). Never reformatted — the hedge is part of the claim.

sortYearHijri.description: DERIVED, for sorting and timeline spacing only. Negative = before Hijra (ق.هـ). Start of a range. Never display this as a date.

sortYearGregorian.description: DERIVED, for timeline spacing only. First year mentioned in the Gregorian cell. Never display this as a date.

authenticity.description: The source document grades its own rows. Carrying this through is what separates this from a storybook.

mark.description: From the row's own marker: ✓ = verified, ≈ = approximate, ✓/≈ = mixed, none = unmarked.

qualifier.description: The scope the row attaches to its marker, e.g. 'من حيث أصل الرواية' — verified as to the origin of the report, not every detail.

grade.description: Date-certainty grade, set only for events the source names explicitly in its A/B/C section. Null means the source did not grade it — not that it is ungraded-good.

needsSeparateStudy.description: Set where the source itself says the event has contested details requiring separate study.

placeText.description: Verbatim place cell, including movement arrows such as 'مكة → المدينة'.

locations.description: Resolved ids into locations.json, in the order they appear in placeText. Two or more ids where the event is a journey — the map should then draw both pins.

routeId.description: Key into routes.json for events that are journeys. The route is drawn in addition to `locations`, which stays exactly as the source gave it.

movement.description: True when placeText describes travel (→) rather than a single site.

quranRefs.description: Qur'an references quoted in this event, as "sura:ayah". Identical across languages.
